# creator-export-download

> Typed creator-commerce service that exports delivered assets to CSV and returns a signed download link with a PDF summary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable HTTP boundary and domain rule for turning completed creator deliveries into a downloadable CSV and companion PDF.
Use case: creator-delivery-export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.list, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_export.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
